application.name: Recorder
application.description: Records synthetic streams (RGB8 and MONO16 from the GPU, MONO8 and NV12 from the host, and a tensor) with holoscan-recorder's RecorderOp, replays them with ReplayerOp into host and device memory and checks every byte, capture time and frame id; replays a recording or a stereo camera clip into a HoloViz window; and measures what the disk takes from a live camera.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-recorder demo, with a byte-exact record and replay check, a HoloViz replay of recordings and stereo camera clips, and a recording benchmark.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: Display
hardware.description: For the HoloViz window of the replay mode.

data.name: Stereo camera recordings
data.description: Optional: the RealSense D585 clips in $HOLOSCAN_TEST_DATA/stereo-camera/, for the replay mode and the real-data tests. Not part of this repository.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 frames of five synthetic streams recorded, then replayed into host and into device memory, every sample checked byte for byte with its capture time and frame id.

replay.description: Replays the RGB images of a stereo camera clip in real time, in a loop, in a HoloViz window; needs a display and $HOLOSCAN_TEST_DATA.

bench.description: Records a synthetic 1280x720 RGB8 camera at 30 fps for 10 s through kDropOldest edges and reports the rate the disk took and the frames dropped.
